text:
Evelyn R: quick sync: sales surfaced a customer wanting a single "performance+compliance" SKU. bundles: reserved throughput, on-prem connector for validation, priority routing, and a "soft-unlimited" burst with negotiated caps. they want pricing and a clear escalation path.

Sam W: high-level: bundling these into one SKU simplifies sales but makes billing + risk harder. we need clear surcharge/discount math and a hard limit in the contract. can we make burst 'soft' (allowed but metered + surge fee) rather than unlimited?

Kai L: ops implications: on-prem connector for a pilot -> we should only allow read-only test hooks. permanent installs require SOC and infra review. priority routing needs per-tenant queue and a fallback lane if capacity exhausted. that's doable but needs feature-flag + auto-throttle.

Meera S: docs: entitlements matrix is required. users must see "what you get" and "what happens when you hit limits". i'll prepare a short matrix and an FAQ explaining burst fees and upgrade steps.

contracts-bot: auto: initial legal guidance: no open-ended burst. recommend tiered burst bands with explicit approval thresholds. include liability cap tied to fees paid. will draft exhibit.

Evelyn R: proposed commercial constructs:
```
- SKU: Performance+Compliance
- Base: committed RPS + monthly token pool
- Burst: up to 2x committed free for 1h/day; additional burst metered at surge rate
- On-prematory: pilot-only connector w/ read-only data plane; permanent requires SOC attestation
- Priority routing: bronze/silver/gold tiers with latency SLOs; gold requires reserved warm nodes
```

Sam W: pricing ask: model three scenarios (30%/100%/250% burn). include per-token uplift and implied margin delta. I'll run numbers if you confirm committed RPS and token sizes.

Kai L: ops checklist: 
1) feature-flag perf_comp_sku enabled
2) per-tenant priority queue + metrics (p95/p99)
3) throttle policy: degrade to committed RPS when credits exhausted
4) pre-warm option for gold (non-refundable warm-hours)
5) alert: sustained >1.5x committed for 30m

Meera S: docs checklist: entitlement matrix, example billing scenarios (low/typical/high), FAQ, upgrade path bullets, support playbook.

Evelyn R: go/no-go criteria (proposed):
- Pricing model (Sam) done and reviewed by finance
- Legal exhibit for burst & on-prem (contracts-bot)
- Ops feature-flag + throttle + alerts in staging (Kai)
- Docs one-pager + entitlements matrix (Meera)
- AE term sheet and customer sign-off window defined

contracts-bot: will post a draft exhibit by EOD. key points: surge bands, approval flow for exemptions, liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months, SOC gating for permanent on-prem installs.

Sam W: will mock pricing scenarios by tomorrow noon. need committed RPS (customer quoted 250 RPS expected, peaks ~900), avg 450 tokens/req.

Kai L: creating feature-flag and dashboard tile now. ops-bot: created flag perf_comp_sku in staging. ETA for metrics + alert: 48h.

Meera S: i'll drop the entitlements draft to the docs repo and post link here when ready.

Evelyn R: thanks. I'll coordinate a 20m sign-off after artifacts are in. tagging @sales to hold cadence with customer until we confirm constraints. :thumbsup:
